title: Waiting on God
definition: Waiting on God is trusting His wisdom, timing, promises, and faithfulness when answers, relief, provision, or restoration seem delayed.
summary: Waiting on God is active trust in His timing, wisdom, and faithfulness.
christFocus: Jesus trusted the Father's timing completely and teaches believers to walk by faith even when they do not yet see the outcome.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Waiting can be one of the most difficult parts of the Christian life. Believers often wait for healing, restoration, guidance, provision, reconciliation, answered prayer, or relief from suffering. Scripture teaches that waiting is not passive resignation but active trust. God often uses seasons of waiting to deepen faith, develop patience, strengthen character, and teach dependence upon Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers become discouraged because God's timing does not match their expectations. Understanding biblical waiting helps believers remain faithful instead of becoming bitter, impatient, or hopeless.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Continue obeying God while you wait. Do not allow delay to become an excuse for unbelief. Pray honestly, trust God's character, and remember that the Lord is often working behind the scenes even when nothing appears to be changing.
